blockcraftdesc-grindingstone-*: A stone for manually grinding the softest minerals and grains.
gstone:block-handbooktext-gstone:block-g:
Place the item on the grinding stone and process it using a regular granite, andesite, basalt or peridotite stone.

Only the softest items and blocks can be processed this way, for everything else you would need a quern.
Grindable items:
Chalk stone
Halite stone
Sulfur
Borax
Sylvite
Charcoal
Grains
Dried cassava
Small bones
Seashells
